The quotation is about restructuring school governance — requiring all schools to join or form "high-quality school trusts," including those currently run by local authorities. The specific mechanism is an organizational/governance mandate for educational institutions.

The core economic content is about the structure and governance of educational institutions (school trusts as organizational forms), which falls under I2 — Education and Research Institutions.

There's also a dimension of L3 — Nonprofit Organizations and Public Enterprise, since school trusts are a specific organizational form (nonprofit/public enterprise governance structure), but the primary substance is education policy.
